name: fis-experiment-safety-and-blast-radius-auditor
description: Audits a proposed AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS) experiment or template for safety before it runs: stop condition present and bound to a real CloudWatch alarm, target scoped by tags or COUNT rather than all-resources, non-production-first, blast radius limited on the first run, rollback and abort defined, off-peak timing, and no prohibited or critical resource targeted without escalation. It also checks CI/CD continuous-chaos readiness. Read-only and recommend-only - it produces a pass/fail safety scorecard for a human, never starts or modifies an experiment. Recommends the awslabs FIS-recommender MCP server as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on FRI at 08:00 UTC
